Public Function Probe() As String
    Dim o As Object, s As String
    Set o = Application.ErrorCheckingOptions
    s = s & "|BackgroundChecking=" & TypeName(o.BackgroundChecking) & ":" & CStr(o.BackgroundChecking)
    s = s & "|EvaluateToError=" & TypeName(o.EvaluateToError) & ":" & CStr(o.EvaluateToError)
    s = s & "|TextDate=" & TypeName(o.TextDate) & ":" & CStr(o.TextDate)
    s = s & "|NumberAsText=" & TypeName(o.NumberAsText) & ":" & CStr(o.NumberAsText)
    s = s & "|InconsistentFormula=" & TypeName(o.InconsistentFormula) & ":" & CStr(o.InconsistentFormula)
    s = s & "|OmittedCells=" & TypeName(o.OmittedCells) & ":" & CStr(o.OmittedCells)
    s = s & "|UnlockedFormulaCells=" & TypeName(o.UnlockedFormulaCells) & ":" & CStr(o.UnlockedFormulaCells)
    s = s & "|EmptyCellReferences=" & TypeName(o.EmptyCellReferences) & ":" & CStr(o.EmptyCellReferences)
    s = s & "|ListDataValidation=" & TypeName(o.ListDataValidation) & ":" & CStr(o.ListDataValidation)
    s = s & "|InconsistentTableFormula=" & TypeName(o.InconsistentTableFormula) & ":" & CStr(o.InconsistentTableFormula)
    s = s & "|MisleadingNumberFormats=" & TypeName(o.MisleadingNumberFormats) & ":" & CStr(o.MisleadingNumberFormats)
    s = s & "|IndicatorColorIndex=" & TypeName(o.IndicatorColorIndex) & ":" & CStr(o.IndicatorColorIndex)
    s = s & "|Type=" & TypeName(o) & "|Parent=" & TypeName(o.Parent) & "|Creator=" & o.Creator
    Probe = Mid(s, 2)
End Function
